   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "fa26dc7f",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# `trim_saddle_points_legacy`\n",
    "Removes peaks that fall on a saddle or ridge in the distance transform rather than on a true local maximum. This is the version that shipped with PoreSpy < 2; it is more aggressive in trimming than the current `trim_saddle_points` and is kept for legacy reasons."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "e84d3bb3",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-04-27T20:26:37.968654Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-04-27T20:26:37.968299Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-04-27T20:26:39.758445Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-04-27T20:26:39.757976Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "import porespy as ps\n",
    "from porespy.tools import get_edt\n",
    "\n",
    "ps.visualization.set_mpl_style()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "f5a8e92a",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The arguments and their defaults are:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "f2e01f1c",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-04-27T20:26:39.760140Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-04-27T20:26:39.759979Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-04-27T20:26:39.777593Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-04-27T20:26:39.777116Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<Signature (peaks, dt, maxiter=10)>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 2,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import inspect\n",
    "\n",
    "inspect.signature(ps.filters.trim_saddle_points_legacy)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "82714fad",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## `peaks` and `dt`\n",
    "`peaks` is a boolean image with `True` at candidate peak locations (typically the output of `find_peaks` plus `reduce_peaks`); `dt` is the distance transform of the void phase the peaks were found in."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "2e044f26",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-04-27T20:26:39.778872Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-04-27T20:26:39.778768Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-04-27T20:26:39.987204Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-04-27T20:26:39.986079Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1000x500 with 2 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {
      "image/png": {
       "height": 484,
       "width": 946
      }
     },
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "im = ps.generators.blobs(shape=[200, 200], porosity=0.6, seed=0)\n",
    "dt = get_edt()(im)\n",
    "peaks = ps.filters.find_peaks(dt=dt)\n",
    "peaks = ps.filters.reduce_peaks(peaks=peaks)\n",
    "\n",
    "trimmed = ps.filters.trim_saddle_points_legacy(peaks=peaks, dt=dt)\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=[10, 5])\n",
    "ax[0].imshow(peaks / im, origin='lower', interpolation='none')\n",
    "ax[0].set_title('candidate peaks')\n",
    "ax[0].axis(False)\n",
    "ax[1].imshow(trimmed / im, origin='lower', interpolation='none')\n",
    "ax[1].set_title('after trim_saddle_points_legacy')\n",
    "ax[1].axis(False);"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "90b81623",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## `maxiter`\n",
    "Maximum number of iterations the dilation-and-compare loop is allowed to run per peak before giving up. The default is 10. If you suspect peaks are being spuriously dropped, increase this."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "3a11e2a4",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-04-27T20:26:39.990484Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-04-27T20:26:39.990220Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-04-27T20:26:40.024037Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-04-27T20:26:40.023599Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "maxiter =  3  ->  peaks remaining: 61\n",
      "maxiter = 10  ->  peaks remaining: 55\n",
      "maxiter = 30  ->  peaks remaining: 55\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "for n in [3, 10, 30]:\n",
    "    trimmed = ps.filters.trim_saddle_points_legacy(\n",
    "        peaks=peaks, dt=dt, maxiter=n)\n",
    "    print(f'maxiter = {n:>2}  ->  peaks remaining: {int(trimmed.sum())}')"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "eb76d92f",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "> **Note**\n",
    "> For new code, use `trim_saddle_points`. This legacy function is kept only to reproduce results from PoreSpy < 2."
   ]
  }
 ],
